verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents official SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js and an HTTP API for event ingestion (hightouch-docs-6/38/7/39/41), plus a REST API with API-key auth and AI-scoped keys (hightouch-docs-13/33/50) that an AI-native user could build against. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probe found 404s at standard OpenAPI paths) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK usage beyond first-party docs.
